presentation.summary: An Xbox-inspired system dashboard: one decisive green, squared chrome, and a fast horizontal blade strip.
presentation.description: XSquare sits on top of your cover art like an operating system — squared geometry, a single confident green for focus and active states, wide landscape blade tiles in a horizontal strip, and a dense, left-anchored readout. Motion snaps rather than glides. It renders only real game data.
